subject.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution

question: Should `current` and `session:*` cron jobs automatically gain runner fallback announce delivery despite being persistent conversation targets?
rationale: This changes stored default delivery behavior and creates a second output path for persistent sessions; the existing docs and merged session-target restoration favor preserving isolated-only implicit announce, but accepting a new default requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Preserve isolated-only default
options.body: Keep implicit announce scoped to isolated jobs and ask for a runtime reproduction before considering a narrower persistent-session delivery fix.

options.title: Adopt persistent-target announce
options.body: Explicitly approve the new default, then require upgrade, duplicate-delivery, and fresh-install proof for both `current` and named sessions.

recommendation.title: Preserve isolated-only default
recommendation.body: Keep implicit announce scoped to isolated jobs and ask for a runtime reproduction before considering a narrower persistent-session delivery fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The persistent session-target contract was most recently restored and documented through their merged cron work.
